_note: Megumi Fushiguro appearance skins. Ramps are dark -> mid -> light (hex). Regions: hair, uniform, fx (bright effect / weapon-arc pixels), shadow (dark pixels outside the body column: domain spread, sign aura). Skin tones, eye marks, warm gold accents and the outer 1-px outline are never recoloured. 'stars' / 'circuit' = deterministic static pattern written into uniform pixels only.

skins.name: Natural Shadows
skins.inspiration: Original: the Ten Shadows read as ink — charcoal-indigo uniform, blue-black hair, violet-ink shadow effects. A subtle take on the default.

skins.name: Cursed Rose
skins.inspiration: Original: wine-dark uniform, crimson-black hair, rose-pink cursed-energy effects.

skins.name: Infinity Frost
skins.inspiration: Gojo-inspired: snow-silver hair, ice-navy uniform, cyan Infinity-blue effects. Colour scheme only — Megumi's geometry is unchanged.

skins.name: Alien X — Ten Constellations
skins.inspiration: Alien X-inspired: void-black uniform with a fixed field of white star specks, white hair, green-white cosmic effects. Static precomputed stars on the uniform only.

skins.name: Upgrade — Shadow Circuit
skins.inspiration: Upgrade-inspired: liquid-black uniform with neon-green circuit highlights, black-green hair, green tech-shadow effects.

skins.name: Ghostfreak — Pale Procession
skins.inspiration: Ghostfreak-inspired: pale ash-grey uniform, deep-violet hair, magenta-purple spectral effects.

skins.name: Eclipse Gold
skins.inspiration: Original: eclipse-black uniform whose highlights turn to gold, black hair with a bronze sheen, gold shadow effects.

skins.name: Abyssal Aquarium
skins.inspiration: Original: deep-sea teal uniform, abyss-blue hair, aqua bioluminescent effects.
